witness_provenance.tool: gf2_fast RIS, pair depth 8, fresh-seed 1M chunks

provenance.construction: Cyclic generalized-bicycle code over Z_341 (same ring as this board's leader [[682,172,78]]), a(x) invariant under j->32j mod 341 (ord=2), b(x)=a(x^8) mod (x^341-1). Weight-10 a(x) support, Frobenius power q=8 (same q used by two other board entries, 682-142-79 and 682-172-76, under a shift).
provenance.notes: Found via a systematic search over the (fixed-points, pairs, q) parameter space of this recipe family, scored against real distance (not a cheap proxy), after earlier sessions established that grau/k alone do not reliably predict distance for this family. d_X=d_Z=89 by the exact qubit-permutation symmetry proven for this cyclic family during the session that produced PR #2755 (negate the index mod 341 in each block, then swap blocks); the Z-witness here was derived from the confirmed X-witness via that permutation and independently re-verified against this entry's own H_X/H_Z, not assumed. Distance confirmed at 8,000,000 trials (gf2_fast, 20 threads, seed=5051), reproduced twice with the identical result. Before submitting, verify/gate_changed.py was run locally with 3 independent seeds against this exact submission, per the post-incident protocol written after PR #2739's correction. Correction (2026-10-04): the board's own CI refutation gate (RIS-fast, 8,000,000 trials) found a weight-87 X-type logical, lighter than the originally claimed d=89. Independently re-verified: the weight-87 X witness commutes trivially with all Z checks and strictly increases rank(H_X) (280->281), confirming it is a genuine non-trivial logical, not a search artifact. The corresponding Z witness was derived via the same exact qubit-permutation symmetry used elsewhere in this family (negate index mod m within each n/2 block, then swap the blocks) and independently re-verified the same way (commutes trivially with all X checks, rank(H_Z) 280->281). d_X=d_Z=87, kd^2/n=1353.99. Distance revision 2026-10-07 by @vaibhav-baj: a weight-81 X-type logical found at 4,000,000 accelerated RIS trials lowers d from 87 to 81; checks and provenance unchanged.
